note: Stage 3 deep dive (studies/04-deep-dive/DESIGN.md). Written before the Stage 3 data was pulled.

hypotheses.statement: Review is getting slower: median time to merge in GitLab's product repo rose over the last two years.
hypotheses.disproved_if: The 95% bootstrap interval of the slope of quarterly median time to merge (Q4 2024 to Q3 2026) includes 0 or is below it.

hypotheses.statement: MRs that disclose AI help take longer to merge than those that don't, at the same size.
hypotheses.disproved_if: Median time to merge, AI-disclosed ÷ not, is ≤ 1.0 in at least two of the three size buckets (1–3, 4–10, 11+ files). Inconclusive under 200 AI-disclosed MRs.

hypotheses.statement: MRs that disclose AI help need more review back-and-forth.
hypotheses.disproved_if: Median review comments, AI-disclosed ÷ not, is ≤ 1.0 in at least two of the three size buckets.

hypotheses.statement: MRs that disclose AI help get reverted more often.
hypotheses.disproved_if: The AI-disclosed revert rate is ≤ the rest. Inconclusive under 10 reverts in the AI-disclosed group.

hypotheses.statement: Small changes reviewed by people from several roles wait much longer to merge.
hypotheses.disproved_if: For MRs with 1–3 files, median time to merge with reviewers from 2+ roles ÷ 1 role is < 1.25 (supported at ≥ 1.5, inconclusive in between).
